title: Specialty Pharmacy Program — The Maximizer Draw Horizon and Coverage Review Approvals
content:
The draw horizon is the span over which a maximizer benefit is spread under the Specialty Pharmacy Program. It depends on the coverage review approval for the drug recorded under the member's **Utilization Management Program**.

**Rule.**

- When a coverage review approval for the drug is in force today and expires before the last day of the program year, the draw horizon runs from today to the approval's expiration date.
- When no approval for the drug is in force today but one is on record, the draw horizon is zero days, and only the fill being paid counts.
- Otherwise the draw horizon runs from today to the last day of the program year.

**Terms.**

- **The approval.** The approval read is the coverage review authorization for the specialty enrollment's therapy drug, granted under the member's Utilization Management Program, with the latest effective date.
- **In force today.** The approval's effective date is on or before today and its expiration date is on or after today.
- **Expires before the last day of the program year.** The expiration date is earlier than December 31 of the program year named on the latest benefit load.
- **Counting.** The horizon is counted in calendar days from today.

## Ladder

| Approval for the drug on record | In force today | Expires before December 31 of the program year | Draw horizon |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | days from today to the expiration date |
| Yes | Yes | No | days from today to December 31 of the program year |
| Yes | No, it has expired or is not yet effective | n/a | zero days |
| No | n/a | n/a | days from today to December 31 of the program year |

## Cases (assumed: today is 2026-10-08, program year 2026)

| Approval for the drug | Draw horizon |
|---|---|
| effective 2026-04-01, expires 2026-11-30 | 53 days |
| effective 2026-04-01, expires 2026-12-31 | 84 days, since December 31 is not before the program year's last day |
| effective 2025-10-01, expired 2026-09-30 | zero days |
| effective 2026-11-01, expires 2027-10-31 | zero days, since it is not yet in force |
| none on record | 84 days |
